Both hooks files register SessionStart in two groups: matcher * with 6 handlers at indexes 0-5 (install-git-hooks.sh --quiet, update-notice.sh, agents-md-config-check.sh, behavior-drift.sh at --soft --deadline 14 / timeout 15; repo-list SessionStart and worktree-prune.sh at --soft --deadline 57 / timeout 60), and matcher startup|clear with nested-steering.sh at --soft --deadline 14 / timeout 15; the two files differ only in the root variable.
Claude Code reads hooks/hooks.json by its default path (.claude-plugin/plugin.json has no hooks key); Codex reads hooks/hooks.codex.json through .codex-plugin/plugin.json:54.

Every SessionStart entry runs hooks/run-hook.py: a plugin handler resolves to hooks/<name>, an absent file exits 0, stdin and stdout are inherited, the whole environment passes through, a run past --deadline is killed with a notice and exit 0, and --soft always exits 0; repo-list SessionStart reads .afk/hooks.json or the repo-hooks path and only warns, since SessionStart is not a blocking event.

Native check E reads both files and accepts only matcher tokens from CAPABILITIES.md:33, which has * and startup and clear but no compact or resume; check J reads hooks/hooks.json only and fixes the form python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run-hook.py" [--soft] [--deadline N] plugin <x>.sh [args]; check M reads both files and refuses a --deadline above min(0.95*timeout, timeout-1). The designed entry --soft --deadline 14 plugin <name>.sh with timeout 15 passes all three; a .py handler or a compact matcher would fail.

Codex trusts plugin hooks by position, <plugin>@<marketplace>:hooks/hooks.codex.json:<event>:<group>:<handler> with trusted_hash; setup H12 probes 3 positions: PreToolUse:2:0 (guard), SessionEnd:0:0 (cleanup) and SessionStart:0:5 (worktree-prune.sh). Appending at SessionStart:0:6 leaves all 3 unchanged.

Unchanged by the append in both files: the 6 existing entries and their indexes, the startup|clear group, and every existing assertion: test_check_hook_trust.py:38 (3 keys), test_remove_worktree.py:151-156, test_protected_branch_acceptance.py:1034-1038 (found[0] stays worktree-prune.sh), test_bench_hooks.py:32-36 (the new handler is reached by the session-start scenario), hook-smoke.sh:820-844 (twins stay equal when both files change), test_native_contract_events.py:52-58 (gate exit 0).

hook-smoke.sh's twin test goes red if the entry lands in only one hooks file.
